status: Plan only; not an executable capability or new admission limit
target: Full native component documents up to Photoshop2026dimension/workflow limits; do not narrow to the present8MPcap
findings: Indexed native blobs already authenticate arbitrary bounded Data by SHA256/ordinal; raw component bytes must not be reinterpreted as RGBA Pixel tiles.
Current NativeModeRaster encoder materializes legacy planes; its decoder reserves logical dense bytes and then reconstructs blocks. These paths still require8MPadmission.
ComponentPlane has exact raw blocks, implicit fills, immutable private mapped snapshots and a bounded presence map, but no portable streamed component codec.
Surface logical sample equality is now tested across implicit/owned/mapped layouts, enabling cache reconstruction without representation-driven false history/stale differences.

implementation_sequence.work: Add bounded raw component block records and hierarchical pages with an implicit word, depth, dimensions, root and declared count; authenticate each page/sample blob through shared archive contexts.
implementation_sequence.why: A flat all-block array grows with the full dense document; a hierarchy keeps each page bounded and the document manifest small.

implementation_sequence.work: Decode bounded pages/blocks into validated immutable component scratch, with exact counts/order/unique keys, dimensions, finite words/alpha range, padding policy, cancellation, I/O/admission and ownership checks.
implementation_sequence.why: Budget actual resident index/transfers separately from virtual/logical component bytes; reject malformed input atomically.

implementation_sequence.work: Integrate native/history file versions and preserve legacy1–85read paths; explicitly bound Data/history fallbacks that still require dense memory.
implementation_sequence.why: A format marker must distinguish new page semantics. A small working document need not be called a new semantic feature merely because file encoding improves.

implementation_sequence.work: Integrate creation/conversion/cache/channel operations, document and recovery memory admission, save/reopen and optional native/API file jobs. Update parameter/result/capability/error metadata and version coverage in the same executable increment.
implementation_sequence.why: Raise actual admission only with usable end-to-end paths; internal storage tests alone do not establish application capacity.

implementation_sequence.work: Finish PSD/PSB/TIFF component streaming, resampling/reframe/default-change/printing and remaining large-operation policy; test exact numeric/file/native/API/history outcomes and actual Photoshop interoperability.
implementation_sequence.why: Keep original full workflow/capacity acceptance open until every required operation is implemented and verified.

acceptance: Native desktop and both applicable API interfaces share exact component/transaction implementations, truthful capability/schema/version/error behavior and undo/redo.
Owned independent raw byte and saved-file readers, malformed/oversized/cancelled/stale/revoked requests, persistence/history and bounded sparse maximum geometry checks.
Physical dense capacity, supported macOS14+/Intel/Apple Silicon, sustained60fps and exact Photoshop rendering/settings/shortcuts are separate required gates; no closure from module-only tests.
C01_schedule: After full complete and tested S05; original scopes retained
